annotations.text:
A — Icon Rail
Slim vertical avatar rail replaces the wide account list; category + sub-tab collapse into one toolbar row; flows as cards.
Best if: you want to reclaim width for content.

B — Sidebar Category Nav
Categories move into a vertical nav (like Settings pages); sub-tabs nest underneath the active one; flows as a dense data table.
Best if: users mainly scan/manage many flows at once.

C — Card Gallery Home
No tab maze — every feature is a searchable card with live counts; a Recent strip for fast re-entry.
Best if: this page has grown too many tabs to browse.

D — Split Workspace + Insights
Slim top tabs plus a persistent right panel with real numbers (flow counts, weekly volume) and quick actions.
Best if: you want the page to also report, not just configure.

E — Command Bar Minimal
Search-first header, underline tabs, borderless list rows, generous whitespace.
Best if: you want the lightest, calmest version of this page.

F — Accordion Overview
One scrolling page — every category is an expandable section with a jump-to mini-nav, no click-through required.
Best if: users want to see everything without navigating.
